Identity withheld — A top-3 grocery retailer (800+ stores), Retail & Consumer Goods sector, outcome-linked engagement, blended delivery team. Figures are the client's own, shared with permission.
Fresh ordering anchored to history; waste and stockouts coexisted by category.
Cold-chain evidence manual; spoilage discovered at expiry. Markdown timing by manager instinct across 800 stores.

Day-part demand models per SKU-store feed ordering agents proposing quantities within policy; cold-chain telemetry made compliance continuous; markdown intelligence times reductions against sell-through curves. Store managers approve exceptions; the system learns from every override.
